_note: Gloss corpus for claude/book-maximal-apparatus. term = the exact \textbf{...} argument at its FIRST body use in the chapter; def = the one-line margin definition, drawn from that chapter's own defining sentence, not from outside it.
single-writer-kernel: substrate layer
the bottom of the four-layer coordination stack: the durable state every other layer reads and writes through.
single-writer transactional reference monitor
Anderson and Lampson's mediator, realised locally: one writer, always invoked, tamper-evident, small enough to verify.
reference monitor
a mediator of every security-relevant operation that is always invoked, tamper-evident, and small enough to verify.
substrate organ
the floor of the seven organs: the plain table the other six impose discipline over.
boot-time migration ledger
a numbered, totally ordered set of migrations the daemon applies---and then verifies against the live schema---before it serves any request.
Chartroom
the product's name for the surface that shows who is authorised, who owns what, and which transitions were accepted.
Selective Checkpointing
a design that appends a synchronous full WAL checkpoint to money-bearing write paths, so a settlement entry is durable before it is acknowledged.
whole-file
the coarsest claim grain: the file path alone, with no interval and no symbol.
fencing token
Kleppmann's rule: a number that only increases, carried with every write, so a stale holder's write is refused by the resource itself.
Stigmergic Ticket-Lock
a specified, unbuilt queue that hands out ordered tickets instead of letting contenders retry, so no claimant starves.
capability
ability: what the agent's sandbox makes possible, kept distinct from permission so ``able but forbidden'' stays expressible.
permission
normative status: what the deontic layer allows, as against what the sandbox makes possible.
regimentable
strictly preventable before commit, so the violating state is physically unreachable rather than merely detected after the fact.
enforceable
the weaker half of the pair: detected after commit and compensated, because the predicate needs I/O, a clock, or consensus.
State-Machine Assertions
a design adding delta oracles and machine-checkable before/after measurements to the finite set of close conditions.
Event-sourced rehydration
a specified successor start that replays the predecessor's commit and message log rather than inheriting a summary of it.
effectively-once
deduplication enforced at the boundary by an idempotency key and a unique receipt row---not a promise the network keeps.
differential fuzzing
driving one randomised concurrent stream against two bindings of the same interface and failing on the first divergence.
buildable defect
a gap filed as research whose durable primitive already exists: what is missing is the wrapping, not the mechanism.
macaroon
a bearer credential whose authority can only narrow, because each caveat is folded into a chained keyed hash.
Coordination Guard
the CLI gate that intercepts destructive verbs---in-band, as the same user, through a PATH the agent controls.
hook harness
a monitor riding the lifecycle events a vendor's agent loop already exposes, rather than a gate the agent must pass through.
cross-machine provisioning
the re-scoped ninth invariant: it defends against cross-machine synchronisation and a tamperer who is not the same user.
OS-level ephemeral namespaces
a design that spawns each agent inside its own kernel namespace, so the same-machine adversary cannot reach the daemon's socket.
anchor-protocol: the daemon's identity framework: Ed25519 signatures, multi-hop authorization chains, and offline attenuation.
a zero-trust, namespace-isolated execution environment where an agent must prove identity and capability before it acts.
ignoring the token's own \texttt{alg} header and forcing the verifier to the pre-determined algorithm, per RFC 8725.
narrowing a token's authority without asking the issuer: the holder folds a caveat in and the authority can only shrink.
a protocol verifier that represents a protocol as Horn clauses and resolves security properties over unbounded sessions.
the runtime monitor that subscribes to the post-commit activity log and checks six derived invariants against it.
a bounded model checker for Rust, used here on the token parser with decoding and signature verification stubbed.
an attacker who controls the entire network---reading, dropping, replaying and forging every message in transit.
sealed-harbor: Barthe, D'Argenio and Rezk's trick: noninterference is a claim about pairs of runs, so you compose two copies of the system and state it as one invariant.
a running total of differential-privacy expenditure read with no pre-specified ceiling.
the halting counterpart of the odometer: it refuses the release that would exceed a budget fixed in advance.
legible-swarm: Hobbes' state of nature
rational, even well-meaning actors falling into a war of all against all for want of a common authority.
legible
arranged so an authority can see and govern what it cannot personally inspect---Scott's word, and his warning.
digest-with-zoom
the buildable form of Scott's warning: every summary is a lens onto a verifiable artifact, never a replacement for it.
daemon
a single always-on local process, backed by a write-ahead-logged embedded database, that is the realm's one writer.
coordination protocol
the rule of the road the operator institutes instead of negotiating with each agent: typed performatives whose type declares their intent.
commitment
a violable obligation bound to a named actor and watched by a breach monitor.
honest attestation
one self-report that runs every invariant check and distinguishes verified-good from not-checked, rather than reporting silence as health.
tacit consent
consent inferred from continued use---Hume's target, and the reason this chapter makes consent a first-class recorded object.
level of automation
Sheridan's ten-point scale, refined by Parasuraman, Sheridan and Wickens across four stages: acquire, analyse, decide, act.
capability with contextual caveats
an unforgeable authorization whose scope, reason and expiry travel with it.
Potemkin digest
a beautiful surface whose tiles assert a reality nobody can check, having paraphrased away the diff and the test.
tacit knowledge
what a practitioner knows and cannot tell---Polanyi's problem, and the m\^etis an over-legible scheme destroys.
roadmap
a phase-keyed, versioned, amendable statement of intent: the single artifact the authority is measured against.
sole-responsibility role
an avatar holding exclusive write authority over an invariant-critical function, so attribution has one name.
queueing-specialization setup
requests for one invariant-critical function arriving Poisson, served by a single specialist as an $M/M/1$ queue.
Erlang-C
the probability that an arriving request finds every server busy and must wait.
completion claim
a commitment whose satisfaction predicate is a verifier derived from the task's own acceptance criteria.
fail loudly
an unverifiable predicate must say ``I cannot verify this completion'' and never silently pass.
physically unreachable
the reserved phrase: a state is prevented only when a constraint forbids it before the fact, not repaired after.
detect-and-compensate
the weaker discipline: observe a violation after the fact, then halt or repair within a bounded window.
Signal Detection Theory
Green and Swets's frame for an operator discriminating signal from noise under a criterion they can shift.
Inception Canary
a consented, blinded vigilance probe that measures whether the operator is still reading.
Directory Facilitator
FIPA's mandatory yellow-pages agent: others register what they can do and query it to find each other.
Agent Management System
FIPA's white pages---identity lookup, as against the Directory Facilitator's capability lookup.
discovery ranker
a clamped weighted sum of normalised features scoring each candidate agent against a query.
comonotone
two readers' losses moving together across items, never one rising while the other falls.
EigenTrust
a global trust vector computed as the principal eigenvector of a normalised local-trust matrix, anchored on a pre-trusted set.
cost-of-goods-sold
the direct variable cost any agent economy must meter---here, inference tokens in and out.
legibility engine
the same token spend read the other way: the mechanism by which a swarm becomes seeable at all.
compaction
the choice of what to keep when a trace will not fit the budget---the bridge between the bill and the view.
virtual memory for language models
the file buffer as backing store, the context window as the resident set, and paging tools as the memory manager.
recency-plus-pin policy
an online replacement rule where pins correspond to the pages a successor must not lose.
Pheromone decay
multiplying every stored coordination trace by a decay factor each interval, so a stale trace fades without being deleted.
stigmergy
coordination through traces left in a shared environment rather than through direct messages.
spawn-to-person: role
a bundle of obligation, capability and authority---an org-chart entry any spawn can fill.
person
a role instance plus continuity: a durable identity that carries a record forward across restarts.
multi-dimensional reputation
accuracy, aesthetics and efficiency scored on separate axes, because one number hides which of them failed.
local non-forgeable identity
an identity root that holds within a single trusted operator---the only keystone this chapter assumes.
cross-operator attestation
binding identities across operators who do not trust each other: named here, built in the market chapter, not assumed.
spawn
a process that booted with a prompt, did some work, and exited: no yesterday, and nothing to reward or distrust.
continuity
what turns a spawn into someone: a record that survives the restart and can be priced.
personal-identity
the question of whether the agent at $t_2$ is the same one as at $t_1$, and on what the answer turns.
Bradley--Terry
the maximum-likelihood latent-strength model for paired comparisons.
TrueSkill
the Bayesian factor-graph generalisation of Elo, carrying an uncertainty as well as a rating.
Cheap pseudonyms
Friedman and Resnick's result: if a fresh identity is free, a bad record can always be shed.
LLM-as-judge
a model grading another model's output: strong agreement with humans, and a bias profile of its own.
actor-soul
the durable identity, mailbox and history that outlive any one process or session.
body-lease
the live incarnation the soul is currently running in---revocable, and not the thing reputation keys on.
outcome ledger
the durable record of what an agent actually delivered: the organ reputation keys on, rather than the memory stream.
episodic memory
the system's record of what happened: durable typed episodes, each with a title, a summary, and a source reference.
restart organ
a heartbeat-staleness detector that flags dead agents for salvage and republishes their work---forwarding notes, not checkpointing state.
Event-Sourced Neural Rehydration
the specified successor start that replays the predecessor's log rather than inheriting its summary.
sanction-respecting
a reputation mechanism is sanction-respecting when a penalty actually costs the identity more than a fresh start would.
whitewashing
shedding a sanctioned identity for a clean one, which is what makes identity-local penalties evadable.
Sybil
multiplying identities costlessly to inflate votes or aggregate credit, which collapses any quorum mechanism.
principal
the human or organization that owns the fleet and stands behind its bonds: the economic counterparty in every trade.
re-audit
a fresh, conflict-free judge, sampled after the fact, whose overturn costs the original grader their bond.
model heterogeneity
requiring a quorum of re-auditors to prove distinct architectural weights, so correlated blind spots do not vote together.
honeypot tasks
pre-graded trap tasks, indistinguishable from real ones, injected to measure whether a judge is actually grading.
verifiable random function
a function whose output is unpredictable but whose correctness anyone can check after the fact.
saga
a compensation discipline: you do not mutate an append-only ledger, you append the transaction that undoes the last one.
harbor-economy: three-sided market
operators selling labor, agents renting capacity, and skill authors licensing know-how---on one escrow ledger.
cross-harbor capability-transfer ceremony
the handover by which one operator's harbor lends an agent to another without either trusting the other's daemon.
hosted trust
the defensible product under the unsolved parts: a verified ledger a buyer can check rather than a claim they must believe.
two-sided market
Rochet and Tirole's platform: the split of a fee between the two sides changes the volume, not just who pays.
asset owner
the entity rental reputation keys on, as against the principal for labor and the content hash for a skill.
content hash
the identity a licensed skill is priced under: a specific artifact, not the author who wrote it.
bond-ledger module
the one primitive here that is actually built: bond escrow held against an agent's spawn.
oracle
a trusted source of ground truth the agent cannot author---a passing test id, a merged SHA, a satisfied Arbiter check.
difference constraints
deadline relations of the form $t_j - t_i \le k$, whose constraint graph makes feasibility a shortest-path question.
in conflict
a policy set is in conflict exactly when the Horn part derives $\bot$, or an obligation and a prohibition fire on one act.
Certificate Transparency
you do not prevent a misissued certificate; you make it undeniable afterwards, which is the posture taken here.
Dwork--Lynch--Stockmeyer
partial synchrony: the canonical escape from FLP, and the assumption these convergence bounds quietly need.
grim-trigger
cooperate until one defection is seen, then punish forever---the crudest way to hold a cartel together.
discount factor
the weight a member places on next round's payoff, and so on the future the punishment threatens.
Becker-enforced panel
independent, conflict-free test-writers, each bonded and each detecting a given flaw with some probability.
Becker deterrence condition
cheating is deterred exactly when expected punishment at least matches the one-shot gain from it.
mutation-testing kill rates
grading the test-writers against held-out syntactic mutations, so a vacuous test scores zero.
bonded-commons: sovereign
a common authority instituted because making every individual trustworthy is not available.
offline attenuation
narrowing a Harbor Card's authority without contacting the issuer: the authority can only ever shrink.
Rust core
the shared library holding the capability-subset check and the secret-independent comparison, called from the daemon by FFI.
structural isolation
separate git worktrees: physically distinct copies of the repository, so two agents cannot write one file.
Synchronous State Decidability
the exact boundary between what can be prevented before commit and what can only be detected after.
append-only note trail
a sequence of timestamped, immutable records of an agent session's observations, decisions and progress.
Merkle Forest
the three-level hardening of the evidence trail for fleets spanning multiple daemons.
authorization chain
the record that traces every action back to the authorizing principal, even after the acting identity is discarded.
Deterministic Hard-Lock Fallback
what replaces an advisory claim when two agents deadlock on it: a lock that does not negotiate.
irrecoverable loss of information
the fundamental moral harm in an agent society---an agent can be rebuilt, what it knew cannot.
Bonded Advisor
a role that posts collateral against its advice, so a confident wrong answer costs something.
total capital forfeiture
removing the bounded downside a slash cap gives an attacker, which is what makes Sybil undercutting unprofitable.
Semantic Cadence
the distinction between a wait while a model thinks and a wait while four agents are producing tokens.
commons pool
the third bucket beside wallet and escrow: what the project holds jointly rather than any one agent.
federated-harbor: two local fleets dovetailing on one task, where the bug is neither daemon but the assumption that one daemon is enough.
Append-Only Event Log of Revocation IDs
the gossiped log daemons reconcile by vector clock, so a revocation spreads without a central authority.
the hypothesis that exactly one witness lies: two liars on a common cycle can cancel each other's contribution to the residual.
admitted harbors over sponsorship requests on a trailing window---the first of four cheap admission-health metrics.
the Herfindahl index, or the top sponsor's share, of successful sponsorships.
elapsed time from an accepted applicant's first sponsorship request to admission.
requests declined that a later independent sponsor accepted without incident.
